title: Sole Source Aquifer designation under SDWA Section 1424(e) FRL-3369-5 — final determination (Buried Valley Aquifer System (BVAS), Sole Source Aquifer Petition)
parties: Miami Valley Regional Planning Commission (Dayton, Ohio)
detail: affected Buried Valley Aquifer System — the sole or principal drinking-water source for the petitioned area; all Federal financially assisted projects in the aquifer area and its principal recharge zone become subject to EPA project review under SDWA 1424(e).

title: CERCLA Section 120 Federal Facility Agreement (Superfund; DoD Installation Restoration Program) — executed (Wright-Patterson AFB Federal Facility Agreement (CERCLA §120))
parties: United States Department of the Air Force (Wright-Patterson AFB)
detail: affected Miami Buried Valley Aquifer (the sole-source drinking-water aquifer; 17 WPAFB supply wells + Dayton/Fairborn municipal well fields) contaminated by VOCs (TCE, PCE, carbon tetrachloride, 1,1,1-TCA, chloroform, 1,2-DCE, toluene) from ≥58 base waste-disposal sites.
